pain.title: Behavior Evidence
pain.description: Only behavior evidence worth governing should enter principle review. This page shows real behavior signals and their chain states observed by PD — not raw chat, raw trajectories, or false claims about behavior change.
pain.honestyNote: PD presents each evidence item individually. Automatic similarity detection is a post-MVP capability. Evidence shown here comes from real pain_events, diagnostician tasks, and candidate records.
pain.validationError: Data format validation failed, please refresh and retry
pain.emptyDescription: When PD detects behavior deviations worth governing, evidence will appear here. You can create feedback signals manually via /pd-pain command or pd pain record.

activation.title: Activation Status
activation.subtitle: Which approved principles are actually in effect? This page shows activation facts — not claims about behavioral improvement.
activation.boundaryText: PD cannot yet count how many times a principle was triggered in subsequent tasks, nor can it automatically judge whether behavior has changed (requires semantic matching and feedback loops, post-MVP).

activation.lifecycleUnavailable: Lifecycle metrics are unavailable for this principle.
